findings.evidence: Absolute local interpreter configured only by the trusted operator, checked before use; shell false, fixed Python -I/-B bootstrap and minimal environment. MIME data and record fields enter stdin only. No model or document field can select the interpreter.

robots.txt is fetched only after the operator passes allow_network and the host is one of four supported agencies; the URL is rebuilt from the validated https host, ssl.create_default_context() verifies certificates and hostnames, redirects are not followed, the body is capped and no page content selects the target.
